text: List kind: a lean 'Checklist' alongside 'Shopping list' (shopping = checklist + optional fields)

Implemented in 0a4dbb3, using the design in this ticket after verifying it against
the code. The ticket's OPEN DECISION (LWW field vs immutable creation-time column)
resolved to LWW field — it slots into the existing list-field machinery on all
three tiers and is what makes "change the kind later" possible.

UI decisions confirmed with the user before building:
- Create dialog preselects SHOPPING (preserves existing behaviour exactly).
- Kind is changeable later, in list properties (non-destructive both ways).
- Overview shows a small per-list kind glyph (cart / check).
- Same item dialog for both kinds, just fewer fields (no separate quick-add flow).

Wrinkle the ticket missed, found during verification: Android's ListFieldsDto has
non-defaulted fields, so a new app against a pre-T-110 server (which sends no
kind) would fail to decode EVERY list and break sync entirely. kind is defaulted
there.

Beyond the ticket's file list: the item ROW also suppresses its quantity/price
detail line on a checklist (a converted list can still hold those values), and
ListsRepo.duplicate() carries the kind over (copying a checklist would otherwise
yield a shopping list).

Verified: server 281 (5 new sync-engine tests: default kind, wire round-trip, LWW
both directions, 422 on unknown kind, conversion preserves item fields), web 149 +
tsc + lint, android testDebugUnitTest + lintDebug SUCCESSFUL. Migration 5 checked
end-to-end against a DB built from the real v1.7.0 schema.

NOT released — batched on main for the next release.
